entries.text: Bug#40126952: Fix openSUSE 16 server package account conflicts Declare user and group virtual provides for mysql and mysqlrouter on openSUSE 16. Each package already creates its corresponding account before installing directories owned by that account. This resolves RPM account dependency conflicts during installation. Change-Id: I3e063355206f459246c8da0c99285b8cd8764f1d

entries.text: Bug#39971459 Members of one Group Replication group assign different … …GNOs to the same transaction Description: Members of one Group Replication group can assign different GNOs to the same transaction during a rolling restart under sustained write load. Analysis: A locally reserved synode carries the member's node index. The proposer may suspend while reserving the synode or waiting for its Paxos cache entry. If a view change renumbers the member during that interval, the reservation retains the old node index and can refer to a slot that now belongs to another member. Fix: After waiting for the Paxos cache entry, revalidate locally allocated reservations against the local node index in the view applicable to the reserved synode. Retry stale reservations through retry_new while retaining the client message. Treat removal of the local member from that view as invalidating its reservation as well. Add XCom unit tests covering reservation ownership across view changes that renumber or remove the local member. The original fix was contributed by Matias Sanchez through #736. Thanks to Matias Sanchez for the contribution. Change-Id: I94a1f31f876e95ebea0ebfe0fb97b4db5232cafb

entries.text: Bug#39724798 Streamline GitHub contribution automation Problem: ======== The GitHub contribution path lacked consistent intake templates, shared local CI entry points, and automated build, test, formatting, ownership, and triage feedback. Pull requests could also define workflow changes that executed before those definitions were merged into trunk. The selected-actions policy prevented the external Codex action from running. Solution: ========= Add structured issue and pull request templates, CODEOWNERS-based review routing, path-based area labels, and an expanded contributor guide while preserving the existing non-code contribution terms. Add scripts/ci helpers for Ubuntu toolchain setup, Ninja and ccache builds, clang-format, and the default MTR test selection. Run automatic PR automation from trunk with pull_request_target. Verify PR merge parents, disable persisted checkout credentials, scope permissions per job, restore caches without saving PR-controlled data, and execute build and MTR helpers from the trusted base SHA. Build Debug configurations with GCC and Clang, run default MTR with six-hour limits, publish statuses on the PR head, assign code owners after OCA verification, reconcile approved PRs daily, and apply PR-only stale handling. Change-Id: I75d87674e369b28a7ac6707ebb796e0d2a8bcd83
